title: Start
body:
A classmate is being made fun of in the group chat.
Memes and jokes are spreading fast, and everyone is reacting with laughing emojis.
Lupe sees it happening in real time.
What should he do?
[[ A. Lupe joins the jokes so he won’t look “boring.” |option1]]
[[ B. Lupe stays silent and just watches. |option2]]
[[ C. Lupe speaks up and tells them to stop, even if it makes things awkward. |option3]]
